author: han0110
content:
It seems all the queue wait spikes come from lighthouse sending `engine_newPayload` in bursts (e.g. the 08:28 UTC spike follows a burst of 30 late requests in 6.3s at 08:25:05). Each burst happens after lighthouse waits for missing data columns (mostly columns 74 and 125) before it can import a payload. Perhaps running our lighthouse as a supernode could fix this, since it rebuilds the missing columns directly?

I'll add another chart to show the request/s received by `zkboost` so we can see this issue more directly in the future.

author: han0110
content: when we set `--execution-endpoint=<zkboost_endpoint>`, will the lighthouse be blocked by missing proof? or it just uses the proxied `engine_newPayload` result and advance? I didn't see any clue showing that it's pending for proof so far, will dig deeper.

author: taulepton_
content: The intention is that when we have both --proof-engine AND --execution-endpoint it should just advance imediately. If it has ONLY --proof-engine then it will wait until it receives k-of-n proofs. I'm not sure if there's a bug but that was the intention at least
